hero.h1: My name is Bartosz Sowa. I code and design.

about.p-1: My name is Bartosz Sowa. I design web sites and code.
about.p-2: When it comes to design, I create pages myself from scratch (like this portfolio for example), but more often than not I work closely on the design with my client. I'm open to collaborating on every detail - it's your website after all, and my primary role is help you realise your vision.

features.p-1: The site looks good across all devices.
features.p-2: Manage the content of your site using a panel with only the functions you need.
features.p-3: The Vue.js framework provides speed unmatched by stuff like Wordpress.
